name: Northfield Dental
notes: Homepage headline: 'Quality dental care for the whole family'. Services page is a bullet list with no pricing or process. No patient stories. Blog has two posts, last one in January. Instagram is stock photos and holiday hours.

gaps.summary: The site describes services but never says why a patient should choose this clinic. Content stopped in January, so search and social are carrying very little.
gaps.hook: Your homepage says 'quality dental care', which every clinic in town says, and there is no patient story anywhere to back it up.

items.finding: The headline is generic and could belong to any clinic. Nothing says who the clinic is best for or what makes the experience different.
items.fix: Rewrite the homepage promise around one patient group and one proof point.

items.finding: There are no patient stories, reviews or before and after cases on the site, which is where anxious first-time patients look.
items.fix: Collect three short patient stories and place one above the fold on each service page.

items.finding: Two blog posts in total, the last in January. Local searches such as 'root canal cost' are going unanswered.
items.fix: Publish a monthly answer to one real patient question, starting with cost and pain.

items.finding: Instagram uses stock photos. Clinics usually earn trust from faces and short explainers.
items.fix: Film short staff intros and a 30 second 'what to expect' for each treatment.

checkNext: Check whether the booking button sits on every service page.
Look for Google reviews and whether the site shows them.
